rule: no metric, threshold or transformation is introduced here that the frozen analysis does not already define

figures.columns: platform, npu, workload, mac, status, cumulative_efficiency
figures.transformation: filter status==EXECUTABLE; plot the frozen cumulative_efficiency column as-is, one panel per (platform, NPU); no recomputation
figures.claim: scaling is workload-dependent and mostly sub-proportional within each platform (Section 4.1)
figures.forbidden: reading values across panels as a cross-generation performance comparison; panels share no absolute axis

figures.columns: metric, class, tested_universe, agreement, disagreement, qualification
figures.transformation: plot the frozen agreement/tested_universe counts per metric per class; classes drawn separately and never pooled into one rate
figures.metric: agreement counts under the frozen X1 comparison universe
figures.claim: ordinal and directional metrics were robust across the tested pairs; thresholded classes were TA-state sensitive (Section 5 / 7.5)
figures.forbidden: pooling CLASS A with CLASS B; reading the bars as a platform-performance ranking; any raw-cycle comparison

figures.transformation: sort by the frozen fvp_normalized_cost; plot both frozen columns as-is. No ratio, difference or error is computed
figures.metric: geometric-mean-normalized relative cost, computed within each domain separately (frozen)
figures.claim: ordinal structure and relative cost shape transfer to the one measurable hardware configuration (Section 6 / 7.2)
figures.forbidden: any error, accuracy, ratio or deviation reading between the two bars; absolute cycle comparison
figures.cross_check: row count and ranking cross-checked against fvp_board_ranking.csv: 7 workloads, 0 inversions

figures.columns: workload, binding_pair, n_ops, member_types, delta, direction
figures.transformation: filter workload==rnnoise_INT8 and binding_pair==B-frozen (14 groups); sort by frozen delta; plot delta as-is
figures.claim: the reversal is distributed across operation groups (Section 7.3); the profiled-group sum (+19,060) is a different measurement boundary from the whole-model delta (+19,000), the 60-cycle difference being the deterministic profiling-boundary residual of Section 9.5
figures.forbidden: reading any single bar as the cause of the whole-model regression; per-operation attribution inside a merged group

figures.columns: workload, n_ops, member_types, SO_delta, SH_delta, DS_delta, SO_dir, SH_dir, DS_dir
figures.transformation: filter workload==rnnoise_INT8; drop groups whose delta is zero in all three modes; sort by frozen DS_delta; plot the frozen deltas as-is
figures.metric: per-group cycle delta, 512 minus 256, per memory configuration
figures.claim: direction is invariant across tested memory configurations while magnitude is not (Section 6.4 / 7.4)
figures.forbidden: attributing the modulation to memory bandwidth; the modes are different artifacts
